Players Committee card image of [[Ambush (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1 image; errata mark “E”), printing: “Lose 1 Force to ▲ up to three troopers. OR Once per game, target three related battlegrounds occupied by your clones. Your Force drains at same and related battlegrounds this turn are +1.” Uploaded unchanged.
